claims.kickoff_quote: Every name above is a skill, and the track subagent loads its own assigned skill itself.
claims.skill_quote: Knowledge pack for implementing secure, compliant payment systems: gateway integration, transaction processing, subscription management, and fraud prevention with emphasis on PCI compliance and reliability.
claims.reasoning: The guide states the loading mechanism — the track subagent loads payment-integration itself rather than the orchestrator pre-loading it. The skill only describes itself as a knowledge pack and says nothing anywhere about who loads it or when; this is orchestration-layer information a skill structurally cannot carry. Load-bearing, keep.
